items.title: How to use and contribute to the Knowledge Base
items.summary: What's in the Knowledge Base, how to find answers fast, and how to share what you know with the team.
items.text: What's here Official SOPs and resources (marked *Official*): the firm's approved procedures, policies, templates and reference guides. When an SOP and a team tip disagree, follow the SOP and flag the difference to your trainer. From the team : tips, how-tos, checklists, templates and lessons learned shared by LSH VAs. Every post is reviewed by an admin before it appears. Finding answers 1. Type a few words in the search box, e.g. *lien reduction*, *intake call*, *itemized bills*. 2. Narrow it down with Official SOPs & resources or From the team , a category or a type. 3. Sort by Most helpful to see what your teammates found most useful. Sharing what you know Click ✍️ Share your knowledge . Good posts are specific and practical: [ ] A clear title that says what someone will be able to do [ ] Steps, an example, and the pitfalls you ran into [ ] The right category and a few tags so people can find it [ ] No client names, case numbers or personal details Choose Question as the type if you want the team's advice. Your post shows as *Waiting for review* under 📂 My posts until an admin approves it. If it's sent back, the reviewer's note says what to change; edit it and send it again. Adding to a post or SOP Use 💬 Add your experience under any post or SOP to add an example, a shortcut or a question. Replies also appear once an admin approves them. Click 👍 Helpful on anything that helped you. The Knowledge Base is for the LSH team only. Please don't share the access code or copy SOPs outside the firm.
